paper_title: Constraints on axion-like particles with the Perseus Galaxy Cluster with MAGIC
coupling_convention: canonical g_agamma = |g_aγ| in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: MAGIC observation of NGC 1275 in the Perseus cluster (41.3 h) sets 99% CL exclusion limits on the ALP-photon coupling g_agamma. The paper reports the strongest limit g_agamma = 3.0e-12 GeV^-1 at m_a = 40 neV (4e-8 eV), being most competitive for masses 40-90 neV and constraining the range 40-400 neV. Scan grid: mass 4e-9 to 1e-6 eV, coupling 5e-13 to 5e-10 GeV^-1. No digitized exclusion curve/table available in provided text; only the minimum-coupling point could be extracted from text, so data_points are approximate and sparse. Note: actual confidence level is 99% (schema restricted to 0.90/0.95). This is an astrophysical (spectral irregularity) bound, not a DM haloscope, so no local DM density applies.
